answer: A tournament bond blocks fakes. Each identity locks 70 credit, takes a ledge in a reed bracket for a three-round voyage: each round, pairs submit reed work; the auditor stamps genuine work with a velvet seal, forged work burns 20 credit, ejecting its identity, and a bracket-rigging ring loses both bonds on replay. The k-th slot costs 30+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,026,000 against 40,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays 30 once.
